name: Research, forensics, and directions
implemented: approved shared-understanding SHA-256 binding for research plans and direction sets
bounded substantial, repair, and audit research plans
progressive corpus retrieval with honest compact-manifest degradation
live-public research fallback owned by the host research capability
claim truth classes: observed, measured, inferred, estimated, recommended, unknown
candidate scoring: evidence 20%, craft 25%, project fit 40%, feasibility 15%
hard evidence and craft eligibility floors
explicit color, media, and density role invariants
3-5 substantial directions with one dominant primary foundation
decision, expert, and evidence progressive-disclosure layers
audit research mode with zero design directions
negative_tests: audit direction target above zero rejected
low craft rejected despite high weighted score
cosmetic direction variants below four dimensions rejected
compact manifest does not claim facet fit without detail
